name: Housecall Pro
description: Housecall Pro is an all-in-one field-service management platform for home-service professionals across 50+ trades — HVAC, plumbing, electrical, landscaping, cleaning, pest control, and more — covering scheduling, dispatching, invoicing, payment processing, and customer communication.
best_for: Home-service professionals across a wide range of trades, from solo operators to large teams, who want one platform covering booking through payment plus optional AI and payroll add-ons.
features: QuickBooks and Zapier integration, plus API access
Optional add-ons: AI customer-service rep, payroll, accounting, business coaching

tiers.name: Basic
tiers.notes: $79/month if billed monthly instead of annually. Additional users +$100/month.

pros: Serves the widest range of trades (50+) of any field-service platform compared here
Published, transparent pricing across all three tiers, both annual and monthly
cons: Additional-user pricing adds up quickly on larger teams
AI customer-service rep, payroll, and accounting are separate paid add-ons, not included
Monthly (non-annual) billing carries a real premium over the annual rate at every tier

faq.question: How much does Housecall Pro cost?
faq.answer: Annual billing starts at $59/month for Basic, $149/month for Essentials, and $299/month for MAX; each tier costs more if billed monthly instead.

alternatives.name: Jobber
alternatives.description: Field service software for quotes, scheduling, dispatching, and invoicing.
alternatives.best_for: Growing home service teams wanting client hub and self-serve booking

alternatives.name: ServiceTitan
alternatives.description: Enterprise contractor management software for large residential and commercial trades.
alternatives.best_for: Enterprise contractors requiring custom reporting and call center management
